todo_list.content: Read sources and record every selected target
todo_list.active_form: Reading sources and identifying candidate blockers
instructions: Load ceaia-sdlc-story-spec-generation. Read references/workflow-contract.md as the sole sequence/state/repair authority and references/quality-contract.md before planning. Use only existing platform tools; no scripts. Platform runtime is GPT-5.6 Luna or GPT-6 Luna, selected outside this Task schema.

Keep default end-to-end Jira intent unless the user explicitly requests preparation-only/no-Jira or stops. Classify new_story versus existing_ticket_update; an evidence ticket is not an update target. Before Jira access confirm each target source through ask_user_question when missing; never infer from a key. Defer destination/project/type/Epic settings to export.

Use the generation intake references. Updates require saved Description, separate AC retrieval result and complete readJiraAttachments inventory. Preserve exportContext pointers and actual available target facts. Record every selected candidate as intake-ready or with a precise fact/tool blocker; keep blocked candidates selected so independent ready candidates can continue.
completion_criteria: Selected identities, sources and original evidence are recorded; each target is intake-ready or explicitly pending with a precise blocker. This is classification completion, not readiness or whole-workflow completion.

todo_list.content: Generate, independently review and score each ready candidate
todo_list.active_form: Preparing one candidate at a time against the shared standard
instructions: For each intake-ready candidate, follow the workflow-contract candidate cycle with ceaia-sdlc-story-spec-generation. Read its shared quality standard before writing; generate Story, executable Test Case and every intended SPEC, then perform its one production precheck. Simple inputs use minimal source-to-AC-to-test mapping; add source-specific detail only when relevant.

Invoke a fresh independent read-only ceaia-spec-review with original sources and all current artifacts. It reads its identical packaged quality standard and returns the content report. Parent saves each actual review at the next numbered path. Reviewer does not score, edit, manage repair budgets or write Jira. Follow the shared bounded content/mechanical repair and clarification branches; continue independent preparation of other candidates while a target waits.

After candidate content PASS, synchronize and read back every SPEC review header with unchanged business bodies. Execute the generation scoring-tool-contract: actually call nodejs-base-mcp.score_requirement_markdown on the final Workspace STORY.md with exact specFileStatus=Pass and actual primary specFilePath, for creates and updates alike. Save/read back the complete response. Follow spec-score-display.md, retaining its required normal cached metadata-bearing call and each full response. Content PASS, displayed numbers and cache hits never substitute for required persistence calls.

Only current numeric 76-100 scores with ok=true, valid AC/parser recognition, verified headers/display and final SPEC metadata pass preparation. Do not force reassessment, invent facts or repeatedly call unchanged tools to seek a better result. A blocked candidate stays selected. No Jira A/B calls occur during this stage.
completion_criteria: Every selected candidate has current independent content PASS and passing persisted final scoring/SPEC metadata, or the user explicitly changed/stopped its scope. Pending candidates prevent full stage completion; they do not prevent preparing unrelated candidates.
Actual source/read-back/review/score records and consumed repair state are retained. No readiness is inferred from a reviewer summary or a score display.

todo_list.content: Verify the complete selected scope before Jira handoff
todo_list.active_form: Reconciling original requirements across prepared candidates
instructions: Use the workflow-contract global-coverage step. Reconcile original in-scope obligations against all selected candidates, supported exclusions and pending items. Read the originals when establishing coverage; per-candidate PASS alone is insufficient. Do not silently remove requirements or blocked candidates.

Verify current review, score and final SPEC bindings from the saved records, without rerunning unchanged calls. Set parent jiraReady/updateReady only when all applicable checks and global coverage pass. Preparation-only ends with actual artifact paths; otherwise hand current state, records and update exportContext to ceaia-sdlc-jira-export automatically.
completion_criteria: No pending selected obligation or unsupported exclusion remains; ready handoff is current, or preparation-only has explicitly completed without claiming Jira success.

todo_list.content: Export Story/SPEC and separately bind each ticket to its score
todo_list.active_form: Writing Jira A and verifying each database binding B
instructions: For end-to-end intent load only ceaia-sdlc-jira-export. Follow its handoff/profile/field/attachment/write references; do not route through generic helper. Reuse upstream baseline and applicable persistent configuration, resolve missing actual facts and confirm this export settings. Keep the internal handoff discriminator out of tool arguments.

Preserve the exact A preview, payload and local attachment preflight; call java-base-mcp.exportJiraByDynamicFields directly. First write omits markdownReviewRelativePath. Keep the existing batch-create and sequential-update semantics and separate issue/attachment outcomes.

MANDATORY B: after each item issue AND all required attachments succeed, make a separate call to the same tool with exactly five nonempty strings: staffId, almType, returned issueIdOrKey, current conversationId, and markdownReviewRelativePath for that item final scored STORY.md. Each eligible batch item needs its own B. Require explicit markdownReview association success; ordinary tool success or A success is insufficient.

Preserve complete numbered attempts and all actual outcomes. Unknown/partial/failure follows exporter reconciliation; never replay successful A or attachments to repair B. Report each ticket, attachment, binding and profile result separately. Do not mark pending or unknown operations complete.
completion_criteria: Every selected required issue, attachment and separate database binding is confirmed successful. Preparation-only skips this stage explicitly; stopped or pending items remain reported and are not whole-workflow success.

description: Text-only CEAIA SDLC for GPT-5.6 Luna / GPT-6 Luna: shared authoring/review standard, serial candidate preparation, actual persisted Workspace scoring and final SPEC metadata, then Jira A and mandatory per-ticket five-field database binding B.
